zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 日本H3火箭第9次飞行 拟发射准天顶卫星MICHIBIKI QZS-7
zh.description: 2026年6月15日，JAXA 正式发布新闻稿，公布准天顶卫星系统 QZS-7 搭乘 H3 火箭 F9 飞行的重新排定发射时间窗口。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JAXA H3 火箭复飞成功 30构型试验飞行器精确入轨
zh.description: JAXA H3火箭复飞任务6月12日从种子岛发射升空，6月15日经任务报告确认二级火箭按预定轨道精确注入，复飞取得圆满成功。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 韦伯太空望远镜解开「小红点」之谜：早期宇宙黑洞驱动的能量源
zh.description: 2026年6月15日公布的研究显示，詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜在宇宙学红移3.5(大爆炸后约18亿年)处的「小红点」观测呈现多项独立指标，均指向黑洞驱动的恒星结构，有望最终解开这一困扰学界多年的早期宇宙谜团。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 力箭一号遥十四一箭八星发射成功 民商火箭年累计入轨卫星破百
zh.description: 2026年6月15日11时44分，中科宇航力箭一号遥十四在东风商业航天创新试验区以一箭八星方式发射成功，力箭一号累计入轨卫星达105颗，成为国内首个破百的民商火箭型号。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 长征十二号基本型 6 月 17 日再出征 商业航天发射场二号工位再启
zh.description: 据文昌航天观礼中心消息，长征十二号基本型将于 2026 年 6 月 17 日上午在海南商业航天发射场商发二号工位执行新一轮发射任务，这是该型火箭继 2024 年 12 月首飞后的又一次发射。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: NASA SpaceX CRS-34龙飞船载满空间站科研成果返回地球
zh.description: 2026年6月15日,执行第34次SpaceX商业补给任务的龙飞船搭载干细胞扩增、心脏组织肺炎感染、零沸点贮箱等多项ISS科研成果在太平洋溅落返回地球。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: OHB启动ESA-JAXA RAMSES阿波菲斯探测器组装 锁定2028年春季发射
zh.description: 欧洲OHB公司正式启动ESA与JAXA合作的RAMSES小行星探测器组装,并签署HAMLET高光谱相机合同,任务目标2028年春季发射,赶在阿波菲斯2029年近地飞掠前抵达。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 天舟十号货运飞船发射 创中国货运飞船最重载荷纪录
zh.description: 天舟十号货运飞船于2026年5月（窗口内）由长征七号运载火箭从文昌发射升空，携带中国货运飞船迄今最重载荷补给天宫空间站。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 亚马逊Kuiper星座发射受阻：数百颗卫星排队等待运力
zh.description: 2026年6月16日Ars Technica报道，亚马逊Project Kuiper星座有数百颗卫星排队等待发射，Ariane 6 VA269任务将于6月17日从法属圭亚那发射36颗Amazon Leo卫星创下单次载荷新纪录，但运力瓶颈仍未解决。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 钱德拉X射线望远镜捕捉M87黑洞喷流时序演化最精细图像
zh.description: NASA钱德拉X射线天文台于2026年6月16日发布M87黑洞喷流观测结果，在亚0.1角秒分辨率下首次呈现喷流随时间的演化细节
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 钱德拉X射线观测14年数据：超新星残骸亮度异常波动 颠覆传统认知
zh.description: 2026年6月16日发布的研究显示，钱德拉X射线天文台14年观测数据揭示多颗超新星残骸亮度出现剧烈波动，而非预期中的缓慢衰减。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 中国朱雀二号E火箭上面级在近地轨道解体 距星链星座运行区仅数百米
zh.description: 2026年6月16日报道，中国蓝箭航天朱雀二号E运载火箭6月9日发射后上面级在近地轨道解体，产生约100-150块碎片，所处空域紧邻SpaceX星链星座密集运行带引发关注。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 国际空间站漏气加剧 NASA拒绝俄方在漏气舱段开孔检查方案
zh.description: 2026年6月16日，国际空间站空气漏率急剧上升，SpaceX Crew-12航天员与NASA宇航员Chris Williams被迫转入Crew Dragon避险，NASA正式拒绝Roscosmos提出的在漏气舱段开孔检查方案。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST 揭示 WASP-121b 极端天气：风速 11000 英里/小时 夜间下起红蓝宝石雨
zh.description: 2026年6月16日：JWST 详细刻画热木星 WASP-121b 紊乱大气，测得约 11000 英里/小时（约 17700 公里/小时）风速，并揭示夜间由金属氧化物凝结形成的「红蓝宝石雨」。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST 揭示 WASP-94A b 大气昼夜循环：晨多云 暮晴朗
zh.description: 2026年6月16日：发表于《Science》的研究借助 JWST 一种新观测技术，刻画热木星 WASP-94A b 的昼-夜大气循环，发现晨间多云、傍晚转晴的清晰规律。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 长征三号乙五个月来首次复飞 成功发射实践三十一号卫星
zh.description: 2026年6月16日17时45分,长征三号乙/远征一号运载火箭从西昌卫星发射中心2号工位点火升空,将实践三十一号卫星送入太空,标志着该型号在五个月停飞后重返发射任务。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: Artemis III 全男班机组引争议 佛州民众反应不一
zh.description: 6月16日佛州地方媒体报道，NASA Artemis III 全男班机组成员公布后舆论反应不一，航空航天工程师就历史任务的多样性发表评论。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: SpaceX Dragon 货运飞船准备脱离空间站返回地球
zh.description: 2026年6月16日，SpaceX Dragon 货运飞船在向国际空间站 Expedition 任务交付近6,500磅（约2,950公斤）食品、补给和设备后，准备脱离空间站返回地球。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 韦伯与哈勃揭示银河系形成遗存：球状星团 Terzan 5 含四代恒星
zh.description: 2026年6月16日，ESA/韦伯发布研究确认球状星团 Terzan 5 包含四代独立恒星群，是银河系核球的化石碎片。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 阿里安6号首飞四助推构型 一箭36星创阿丽亚娜家族最重载荷纪录
zh.description: 2026年6月17日，Arianespace在法属圭亚那库鲁航天中心发射VA269任务，阿里安6号首次以全部4枚P160C固体助推器构型升空，将36颗Amazon Leo宽带卫星送入轨道，创下阿丽亚娜火箭家族史上最重有效载荷纪录。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 蓝色起源承诺年内复飞新格伦 5月底发射台爆炸后已动工重建
zh.description: 2026年6月17日 蓝色起源向NASA及阿尔忒弥斯项目合作伙伴承诺2026年内让新格伦火箭重返飞行 公司表示已开始在佛罗里达重建5月28日发射台爆炸中被毁的发射设施
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: SpaceX猎鹰9号第13次复用创纪录 一次送53颗星链卫星入轨
zh.description: 2026年6月17日，SpaceX猎鹰9号从肯尼迪航天中心升空完成第13次飞行，创下火箭复用新纪录，一次性将53颗星链卫星送入轨道。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST揭示熔岩行星55 Cancri e拥有富氢活跃大气层
zh.description: 2026年6月17日，JWST对熔岩系外行星55 Cancri e的凌星观测显示其拥有富氢、以CO为主、含少量CO₂的大气层，与纯岩石蒸气模型不符。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 韦伯借助引力透镜发现大质量星团 揭示早期星系的天然诞生地
zh.description: 2026年6月17日发表于 A&A 的论文报告，韦伯空间望远镜借助引力透镜探测到一批年轻大质量星团，被认为是高红移星系的构建模块。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 中国快舟十一号运载火箭从酒泉发射升空
zh.description: 2026年6月17日 03：40 UTC，中国航天科工集团快舟十一号运载火箭从酒泉发射场升空，HYDROPAC 1725/2026 随后发布对应再入通告。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: Rocket Lab 电子号火箭为 Synspective 执行第十次 StriX 专项发射
zh.description: 2026年6月17日 20：40 UTC，Rocket Lab 从新西兰玛希亚半岛发射电子号火箭，为日本 Synspective 完成 StriX 合成孔径雷达星座的第十次专项部署。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 神舟二十三号发射升空 3 名航天员进驻天宫空间站
zh.description: 2026年6月17日，中国在文昌发射场用长征二号F遥十三运载火箭发射神舟二十三号载人飞船，3名航天员进驻天宫空间站，开启中国迄今最雄心的长期载人飞行任务。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: SpaceX 猎鹰9号清晨发射3颗巨型BlueBird直连蜂窝卫星
zh.description: 2026年6月17日清晨，SpaceX猎鹰9号从佛罗里达发射3颗AST SpaceMobile BlueBird 8/9/10巨型直连蜂窝卫星，为下一代手机直连卫星宽带服务部署关键节点。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: ULA Vulcan火箭发射美太空军任务 固体助推器异常正接受调查
zh.description: 2026年6月中旬，ULA Vulcan Centaur火箭成功发射美太空军机密载荷集群（USSF/neighborhood-watch卫星），但升空后固体助推器出现异常，目前调查工作已启动。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 韦伯望远镜捕捉到在极端椭圆轨道上被恒星炙烤的系外行星
zh.description: 6月17日（URL 发布日期）公开的研究显示，JWST 观测到 HD 80606 b 在极端椭圆轨道上掠过类太阳恒星时遭强烈加热；该行星质量约为木星四倍。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: XRISM观测揭示黑洞风正剥夺巨型星系的造星原料
zh.description: 2026年6月18日发表的研究利用NASA/JAXA XRISM卫星对NGC 4151的观测，发现超大质量黑洞释放的强风可吹走星系形成新恒星所需的气体原料。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: ESA宣布将采购专用SpaceX载人龙飞船任务前往国际空间站
zh.description: ESA宣布计划采购一次SpaceX载人龙飞船专属任务，将欧洲航天员送往国际空间站，这是ESA首次独立包船飞往ISS。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 国际空间站周报：Canadarm2维修计划推进，CRS-34货运龙飞船离港
zh.description: 6月18日ISS周报覆盖CRS-34货运龙飞船离港、Canadarm2机械臂维修计划推进等动态，站上仍停靠载人龙Freedom、天鹅座NG-24及联盟MS-28。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JAXA公布月球探测车月面演示验证结果 小型探月迈出关键一步
zh.description: 2026年6月18日，JAXA联合TOMY、索尼集团和同志社大学公布月球探测车（LEV）月面演示验证结果，标志着利用超小型机器人开展月球探测的可行性验证取得重要进展。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST发现星系之前就已存在的超大质量黑洞
zh.description: JWST对小红点QSO1的观测发现，某些超大质量黑洞从诞生之初就异常巨大，挑战现有星系形成模型。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST拍摄到异常成熟的星系团，打开宇宙正午前沿窗口
zh.description: NASA JWST观测结果在AAS第248次会议上公布，发现一个来自宇宙正午时期的异常成熟星系团，刷新了对该时期星系演化的认知。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST 观测到系外行星 HD 80606 b 近星点时数小时内温度飙升 600°C
zh.description: 2026年6月18日，NASA 韦布望远镜 MIRI 仪器公布观测结果：4倍木星质量的热木星 HD 80606 b 在近星点数小时内温度飙升约1100°F（~600°C），其高层大气化学成分随每个111天轨道周期实时重塑。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST 对温带系外行星做详细光谱分析，确认大气中富含甲烷
zh.description: 天文学家利用 JWST 对一颗温带系外行星进行详细光谱分析，确认其大气中含有丰富甲烷，行星处于温和轨道环境（2026-06-18）。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 中国空间站开展水稻「种子到种子」全周期种植实验
zh.description: 2026年6月18日，中科院报道神舟二十三号航天员在中国空间站进行水稻全生命周期种植实验，设计完成两个「种子到种子」周期，由中科院分子植物科学卓越创新中心团队主导。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 中美火星采样返回竞赛：NASA押注商业新秀 vs 中国稳步推进天问三号
zh.description: 2026年6月18日，Sputnik分析中美火星采样返回任务进展：中国天问三号任务稳步推进，NASA则押注快速发展的商业航天公司。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: NASA 公布 Artemis III 乘组：四名航天员将于2027年近地轨道测试登月关键技术
zh.description: 2026年6月，NASA 正式公布 Artemis III 乘组——指令长 Randy Bresnik、Andre Douglas、Frank Rubio 及 ESA 航天员 Luca Parmitano，任务计划2027年在近地轨道测试登月着陆器关键设备与系统。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: SpaceX第五艘龙飞船Grace抵达国际空间站，Axiom-4私人乘组进驻
zh.description: SpaceX第五艘也是最后一艘载人龙飞船Grace搭载Axiom-4私人宇航员乘组抵达国际空间站，这是星舰服役前龙飞船舰队的最后一个成员。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: BepiColombo探测器完成第三次水星引力辅助飞越
zh.description: 6月19日，ESA/JAXA联合任务BepiColombo完成计划中六次水星引力辅助飞越的第三次，距水星表面约236公里。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 蓝色起源赢得 NASA CLPS 合同 将用蓝色月亮 Mark 2 着陆器于 2028 年送 VIPER 赴月球南极
zh.description: 2026年6月19日，NASA 选定蓝色起源的蓝色月亮 Mark 2 着陆器执行 CLPS 任务，于 2028 年将复活的 VIPER 月球南极水冰探测车送达月面。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 克里斯蒂娜·科赫获2026年阿斯图里亚斯亲王和平奖 表彰其阿尔忒弥斯II绕月任务
zh.description: 2026年6月19日，曾在阿尔忒弥斯II任务中绕月飞行的NASA航天员克里斯蒂娜·科赫获得2026年阿斯图里亚斯亲王和平奖（协和类），这是首位因载人绕月任务获此殊荣的航天员。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 神舟二十三号航天员乘组完成首次应急演练并推进细胞生物学研究
zh.description: 神舟二十三号航天员乘组在中国空间站上完成首次应急演练，并对细胞生物学研究项目进行样品观测、回收与保存。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: SpaceX从范登堡发射NROL-179美国间谍卫星
zh.description: 2026年6月19日，SpaceX猎鹰9号从范登堡太空军基地发射NROL-179任务，将美国国家侦察局（NRO）间谍卫星送入轨道。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 香港首位航天员赖家颖在天宫空间站适应失重 预计近期与港民天地对话
zh.description: 神舟二十三号载荷专家、香港首位航天员赖家颖已在天宫空间站适应微重力环境，预计1至2个月内与香港市民进行天地连线对话。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 国际空间站遭遇冷战式危机：美俄互信崩塌，宇航员被迫躲进龙飞船避难
zh.description: 2026年6月20日，国际空间站星辰号舱段突发严重漏气，NASA下令宇航员撤入SpaceX龙飞船躲避；俄航天局在未充分协调的情况下自行修复漏点，暴露双方深层互信危机。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 朱雀三号可复用火箭一级动力系统热试车成功，9台液氧甲烷发动机并联总推力7542千牛
zh.description: 6月20日，蓝箭航天朱雀三号可重复使用运载火箭一级动力系统热试车成功，9台天鹊-12A液氧甲烷发动机并联总推力达7542千牛。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST发现「粉红星球」含氯化钠云层
zh.description: 2026年6月21日，JWST对2013年发现的系外行星（质量为木星25倍、绕类日恒星运行）进行观测，首次在其氯化钠云层中探测到咸味成分，解答了「粉红星球」颜色之谜。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 长征三号乙/增强型计划在酒泉发射
zh.description: 长征三号乙/增强型运载火箭计划于2026年6月21日前后在酒泉卫星发射中心执行发射任务，载荷信息待公布。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 分析 中国民营航天不容低估 商业航天企业已超 400 家
zh.description: 6 月 22 日分析文章指出 中国民营航天已拥有逾 400 家商业航天公司 正推进可复用火箭 卫星星座和太空旅游等项目
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 中国千帆星座挑战星链全球垄断，IPO前夕密集发射卫星
zh.description: 2026年6月22日，RFI报道中国千帆星座（Spacesail）在规模空前的IPO前密集发射新卫星，从非洲到巴西布局全球宽带，同时面临国内对手SatNet在火箭发射和公共资金方面的竞争。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 商业监测公司确认：中国可重复使用航天器在轨释放物体
zh.description: 商业太空监测公司确认，2026年2月7日从酒泉发射的中国可重复使用航天器在轨释放了一个物体
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 千帆星座运营主体垣信卫星启动新一轮融资，在轨卫星已达约200颗
zh.description: 2026年6月22日，千帆星座建设与运营主体垣信卫星启动新一轮融资，目前在轨卫星已增至约200颗。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JAXA 与 ESA 签署协议 共同参与小行星阿波菲斯 RAMSES 任务
zh.description: JAXA 将为 ESA 主导的 RAMSES 小行星阿波菲斯任务提供太阳翼、热红外成像仪及 H3 运载火箭，以应对 2029 年阿波菲斯近地飞越。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: SpaceX星落再入飞行器原型首飞，为太空制造提供自主回收方案
zh.description: 6月23日，SpaceX猎鹰9号从卡纳维拉尔角SLC-40发射Starfall Demo任务，测试碟形再入飞行器原型，该飞行器可从轨道自主运回最多1000公斤货物，面向太空制造和在轨实验商业化。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 中国空间站启动二次扩容：T字构型将升级为十字构型
zh.description: 2026年6月23日，新华社报道中国空间站将从T字构型升级为十字构型，新增扩展舱段，启动二次扩容规划。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 欧几里得太空望远镜拍出银河系中心最详细图像，为罗曼望远镜巡天预热
zh.description: ESA欧几里得望远镜于3月23日进行26小时连续观测后，于6月24日发布银河系中心区域迄今最详细图像，其中包含51个已知行星系统，同时为NASA罗曼空间望远镜即将开展的巡天任务提供预览。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST 发现天王星新卫星
zh.description: 天文学家利用 NASA 的 JWST 发现了天王星的一颗新卫星，使这颗冰巨星已知卫星数量再添一枚。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 神舟二十二号返回舱带回41公斤关键科技样品
zh.description: 神舟二十二号返回舱成功着陆，带回41公斤来自天宫空间站的关键科学技术样品，科学家将开展多系统详细分析。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 朱雀三号遥二 6 月 24 日发射，将再次挑战一子级回收复用
zh.description: 蓝箭航天朱雀三号遥二火箭计划 6 月 24 日发射，将再次挑战一子级垂直回收复用，有望成为国内首款回收成功的运载火箭。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 中国正在研制7米直径可重复使用火箭
zh.description: 中国正在研制7米直径芯级的下一代可重复使用火箭，与长征十号乙、长征十二号乙并列推进，SpaceNews 报道。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 千帆星座能否挑战星链？中国国家队卫星互联网计划引发关注
zh.description: 卫报6月25日报道，中国国有背景的千帆星座（SpaceSail）6月9日从内蒙古发射卫星，被认为有潜力挑战马斯克星链的全球主导地位。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST首次捕获系外行星被宿主恒星「炙烤」的大气变化
zh.description: JWST在111天偏心轨道上观测HD 80606b，首次详细记录了该行星在近日点前后温度飙升约1100°F时的大气层变化过程。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST拍摄2.23亿像素M82星系照片 揭示1650万颗恒星
zh.description: NASA公布JWST近红外拍摄的2.23亿像素M82星暴星系照片，耗时三天拍摄，展现跨越数亿年的恒星演化图景。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: SpaceX 完成第400次星链发射里程碑
zh.description: 2026年6月25日，SpaceX 猎鹰9号从范登堡太空军基地发射24颗星链V2 Mini卫星，一级助推器B1081完成第25次飞行，这也是星链项目的第400次发射里程碑。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 天问二号据报已抵达地球准卫星 Kamoʻoalewa，即将开展伴飞采样
zh.description: 行星学会6月25日报道称，天问二号探测器据信已抵达地球准卫星 Kamoʻoalewa（2016 HO3），将进行数月伴飞观测与采样，样品计划2027年11月返回地球。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST在宇宙空洞中发现异常明亮类星体
zh.description: JWST回溯宇宙最早期阶段，在宇宙空洞中发现了位于空旷区域的异常明亮类星体，挑战了现有类星体形成模型。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 千帆星座卫星终端首次亮相：手机直连卫星通话，质量比肩5G
zh.description: 垣信卫星在千帆星座终端产品发布会上首次公开展示手机直连卫星通话能力，通话质量比肩5G，标志着中国低轨卫星通信从星座建设迈入终端商用阶段。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: Rocket Lab「十全十美」任务发射 Synspective 第10颗 StriX 卫星
zh.description: 2026年6月26日，Rocket Lab 从新西兰发射「十全十美」任务，将日本 Synspective 公司第10颗 StriX SAR 成像卫星送入轨道，完成该系列的阶段性组网。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST拍摄到早期宇宙中巨型星系与超大质量黑洞同时诞生
zh.description: JWST捕捉到一个早期宇宙大质量星系正在形成的过程，识别出至少6个星系的致密群组，它们预计将合并为一个巨大系统，同步伴随超大质量黑洞的诞生。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: JWST捕捉系外行星近日点极端升温：温度骤升610°C
zh.description: 利用JWST，研究人员首次在系外行星过近日点前、中、后全程观测，发现其在最接近恒星期间温度骤升约610°C。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 神舟二十三号乘组在轨满月：完成新实验安装并重启机器人助手
zh.description: 6月28日天宫TV更新显示，神舟二十三号乘组朱杨柱、张志远、黎家盈在轨满月，完成新实验安装并重启机器人助手，此次任务包含为期一年的在轨驻留试验。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: SpaceX猎鹰9号从范登堡基地发射24颗星链卫星
zh.description: 6月28日，SpaceX猎鹰9号从范登堡太空军基地SLC-4E发射24颗星链v2 Mini卫星，为当周全球六次轨道发射之一。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: SpaceX 猎鹰9号发射 SiriusXM SXM-11 大型通信卫星
zh.description: 2026年6月28日，SpaceX猎鹰9号从卡纳维拉尔角SLC-40发射SiriusXM SXM-11大型通信卫星，一级助推器尝试海上回收。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: Blue Origin称New Glenn将在年内复飞，5月爆炸摧毁发射台后启动重建
zh.description: 2026年6月29日，Blue Origin表示New Glenn火箭将在年内复飞。此前5月28日静态点火爆炸摧毁了卡纳维拉尔角LC-36发射台，NASA已将Artemis III推迟至2027年。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 蓝箭航天朱雀三号遥二可复用火箭完成静态点火试验
zh.description: 2026年6月29日，蓝箭航天朱雀三号遥二可复用运载火箭在东风商业航天创新试验区完成静态点火试验，各系统工作正常，为后续飞行试验奠定基础；该火箭采用不锈钢箭体，面向大型星座组网任务研制。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 朱雀三号遥二面临关键技术挑战：可复用火箭之路并非坦途
zh.description: 蓝箭航天朱雀三号遥二在可复用火箭发射前面临多项关键技术挑战，报道披露了工程团队正在攻克的技术难点。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 国家航天局：我国将建立近地小行星天地协同监测体系
zh.description: 2026年6月30日国际小行星日，国家航天局宣布我国将建立近地小行星天地协同监测体系，为防御小行星撞击提供预警能力。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 长征三号乙火箭成功发射实践三十一号卫星
zh.description: 2026年6月30日，长征三号乙运载火箭成功将实践三十一号卫星送入预定轨道。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: Rocket Lab 发射日本 IQPS 雷达卫星时中止，任务推迟
zh.description: 2026年6月30日，Rocket Lab 在新西兰马希亚半岛发射日本 IQPS 地球观测雷达卫星「稻女神」(Grain Goddess) 时中止发射，任务推迟。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: ULA Atlas 5 完成最后一次 Kuiper 发射任务，551 构型第 110 次飞行
zh.description: 7 月 1 日，ULA 的 Atlas 5 火箭（编号 AV-114）完成 551 构型第 110 次飞行，将 Amazon Kuiper 宽带卫星送入轨道，这也是 Atlas 5 为 Kuiper 星座执行的最后一次发射任务。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 长征六号成功发射18颗千帆星座卫星，G60星座部署再进一步
zh.description: 中国用长征六号火箭成功将18颗千帆星座（G60项目）卫星送入轨道，推进国产低轨宽带通信网络建设。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 千帆星座不止宽带通信，还能辅助北斗导航增强
zh.description: 2026-07-01 报道，千帆星座在宽带通信之外正拓展辅助北斗导航的能力，走与星链不同的差异化技术路线。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 天问二号抵达地球准卫星 Kamoʻoalewa，采样任务即将展开
zh.description: 天问二号探测器于 2025 年 5 月发射后抵达地球准卫星 Kamoʻoalewa，将采集样品并于 2027 年底返回，新研究对其月球起源假说提出挑战。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: XMM-Newton 望远镜助力修正银河系外旋臂距离
zh.description: ESA 的 XMM-Newton X 射线望远镜参与了一项研究，修正了银河系外旋臂的距离测量数据，成果于 2026 年 7 月 1 日公布。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 上海垣信卫星寻求新一轮数十亿融资，千帆星座追赶星链
zh.description: 上海垣信卫星（SpaceSail）正为千帆低轨宽带星座网络筹集新一轮数十亿元资金，成为中国建设自主可控卫星互联网体系的关键商业动作。
zh.author: 天疆说

zh.title: 按日期查阅 · Space News
zh.description: 按年月分组的全部航天新闻条目索引。
zh.author: 天疆说

en.title: China launches Tianlian II-04 data-relay satellite
en.description: Long March 3B lifts off from Xichang on March 26, 2025, placing the Tianlian II-04 GEO relay satellite into planned orbit; 565th Long March family flight.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA and Northrop cancel Cygnus NG-22 cargo mission
en.description: Pressurized cargo module damage in transit leads NASA and Northrop Grumman to drop the planned June Cygnus NG-22 ISS flight; NG-23 targeted no earlier than fall 2025.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Rocket Lab launches eight OroraTech wildfire satellites
en.description: Electron deploys eight OTC-P1 satellites for Germany’s OroraTech from New Zealand; Phase 1 of a planned larger constellation for wildfire monitoring.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Starlink launch from Vandenberg
en.description: Falcon 9 lifts Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, with booster landing at sea (press coverage).
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA announces SpaceX Crew-11 crew assignments
en.description: NASA names four crew members for the next SpaceX Crew Dragon rotation to the ISS, targeting launch no earlier than July 2025 (RELEASE 25-010).
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Fram2 Mission Makes History
en.description: On April 1, 2025, SpaceX's Fram2 mission successfully launched from Kennedy Space Center — the first time humans traveled to a polar orbit aboard a spacecraft.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Shenzhou 20 Crewed Spacecraft Successfully Launched
en.description: On April 24, 2025, China's Shenzhou 20 crewed spacecraft was successfully launched from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, carrying astronauts to the Tiangong Space Station.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Chang'e-5 Lunar Samples Arrive in UK
en.description: In May 2025, lunar samples collected by China's Chang'e-5 mission arrived in the UK, with The Open University becoming the first international institution granted access to study the material.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Launches Yaogan-40 02 Satellite Group
en.description: On May 11, 2025, China successfully launched the Yaogan-40 02 satellite group aboard a Long March-6 modified rocket from the Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Launches Tongce-19 Communications Test Satellite
en.description: On May 13, 2025, China successfully launched the Tongce-19 communications technology test satellite aboard a Long March-3C rocket from the Xichang Satellite Launch Center.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: World's First Space Computing Constellation Successfully Launched
en.description: On May 14, 2025, China successfully launched the world's first space computing satellite constellation aboard a Long March-2D rocket from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Starship Flight 9 Experiences Setback
en.description: On May 27, 2025, SpaceX's Starship Flight 9 (IFT-9) experienced an anomaly during flight and did not complete all planned mission objectives.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Tianwen-2 Probe Successfully Launched
en.description: On May 28, 2025, China's Tianwen-2 probe was successfully launched aboard a Long March 3B rocket from the Xichang Satellite Launch Center, beginning China's first asteroid sample return mission.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Tianzhou-9 Cargo Spacecraft Successfully Launched
en.description: On July 14, 2025, Tianzhou-9 cargo spacecraft was successfully launched aboard a Long March 7 rocket from the Wenchang Space Launch Site in China, delivering supplies to the Tiangong Space Station.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Crew-11 Successfully Launched
en.description: On August 1, 2025, SpaceX's Crew-11 mission successfully launched from Kennedy Space Center, carrying 4 astronauts to the International Space Station.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Starship Flight 10 Achieves Success
en.description: On August 26, 2025, SpaceX's Starship Flight 10 (IFT-10) successfully completed all primary objectives, with the rocket achieving a controlled landing.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Gravity-1 Rocket Achieves Maiden Flight Success
en.description: On October 11, 2025, the Gravity-1 rocket developed by Orienspace successfully completed its maiden flight from a coastal launch site in Haiyang, Shandong Province, placing 3 satellites into orbit.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Starship Flight 11 Achieves Success
en.description: On October 13, 2025, SpaceX's Starship Flight 11 (IFT-11) successfully completed all primary objectives, with both the rocket and spacecraft achieving controlled recovery.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Blue Origin's New Glenn Completes First Mission
en.description: On November 13, 2025, Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket successfully completed its first operational mission, launching NASA's EscaPADE Mars probe.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Shenzhou 22 Crewed Spacecraft Successfully Launched
en.description: On November 25, 2025, China's Shenzhou 22 crewed spacecraft was successfully launched from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, carrying a new crew of astronauts to the Tiangong Space Station.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Zhuque-3 Rocket Achieves Maiden Flight Success
en.description: On December 3, 2025, LandSpace's Zhuque-3 rocket successfully completed its maiden flight from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, marking another breakthrough in China's commercial space sector.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Blue Origin pauses New Shepard suborbital tourism flights
en.description: Blue Origin announces New Shepard suborbital flights to pause for at least 2 years, focusing on lunar capabilities development.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-12 launches to the International Space Station
en.description: On Feb. 13, 2026, Crew-12 lifted off on a Falcon 9 and Dragon from Cape Canaveral SLC-40 for the 12th Commercial Crew rotation mission to the ISS.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Long March 8A maiden flight success
en.description: Long March 8A rocket makes successful maiden flight from Hainan Commercial Space Launch Site on March 13, 2026, delivering 20 satellite internet LEO satellites.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Two Long March launches within three hours in China
en.description: On Mar. 13, 2026, Long March-8A lifted off from Hainan and Long March-2D from Xichang, deploying a LEO satellite internet batch and Shiyan 30C/30D satellites.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Shiyan-30 03 & 04 satellites launched
en.description: Long March 2D rocket launches Shiyan-30 03 & 04 satellites from Xichang on March 13, 2026.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Starlink 17-31 launch from Vandenberg
en.description: Falcon 9 lifts 25 Starlink V2 Mini Optimized satellites from Vandenberg SFB on March 13, 2026; booster B1071 lands on OCISLY.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China launches Yaogan-50 02 remote sensing satellite
en.description: On Mar. 15, 2026, a modified Long March-6 lifted Yaogan-50 02 from Taiyuan; the flight was the 633rd mission of the Long March series.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Kuaizhou-11 Yaoyi-7 rocket launches with 8 satellites
en.description: Kuaizhou-11 Yaoyi-7 rocket launches from Jiuquan on March 16, 2026, carrying 8 satellites including Juntian-1 04A and others.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Shenzhou-21 crew completes second EVA
en.description: Shenzhou-21 crew members Zhang Lu, Wu Fei, and Zhang Hongzhang complete second extravehicular activity on March 16, 2026.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Starlink 17-24 launch from Vandenberg
en.description: Falcon 9 lifts 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg SFB on March 16, 2026; booster B1088 lands on OCISLY; SpaceX Starlink reaches 10,000 satellites in orbit.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Starlink 10-46 launch from Cape Canaveral
en.description: Falcon 9 lifts 29 Starlink V2 Mini Optimized satellites from Cape Canaveral SFS on March 17, 2026; booster B1090 lands on ASOG.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA astronauts complete ISS US EVA 94
en.description: NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Chris Williams complete US EVA 94 outside the ISS on March 18, 2026.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Artemis II SLS rocket rolls out to launch pad
en.description: NASA rolls SLS rocket from VAB to Pad 39B on March 19, 2026, ahead of first crewed lunar orbit mission planned for April.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Starlink 10-33 launch from Cape Canaveral
en.description: Falcon 9 lifts 29 Starlink V2 Mini satellites from Cape Canaveral SFS on March 19, 2026; booster B1077 lands on JRTI.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Rocket Lab launches Strix Earth observation radar satellite
en.description: Electron rocket launches Strix satellite for Japan's Synspective from New Zealand on March 20, 2026.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Starlink 17-15 launch from Vandenberg
en.description: Falcon 9 lifts 25 Starlink V2 Mini Optimized satellites from Vandenberg SFB on March 20, 2026; booster B1100 lands on OCISLY.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Starlink 10-62 launch from Cape Canaveral
en.description: Falcon 9 lifts 29 Starlink V2 Mini Optimized satellites from Cape Canaveral SFS on March 22, 2026; booster B1078 lands on ASOG.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Progress 94 cargo ship docks to the ISS for Expedition 74
en.description: Progress 94 launched from Baikonur on Mar. 22, 2026, and docked to the Poisk module on Mar. 24; TORU manual control was used after a KURS antenna failed to deploy.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Commercial Space Station Companies Push Back on NASA's New Plan at House Hearing
en.description: Companies developing commercial space stations to replace the ISS told a House subcommittee they want NASA to 'stick with the plan' and not make changes that are 'sowing confusion' in the industry.
en.author: SpacePolicyOnline

en.title: China launches Siwei Gaojing-2 05 & 06 satellites
en.description: Long March 2D lifts off from Taiyuan on March 26, 2026, placing two commercial radar Earth-observation satellites into orbit; 634th Long March family flight.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Starlink 17-17 launch from Vandenberg
en.description: Falcon 9 lifts 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg SFB on March 26, 2026; booster B1081 lands on OCISLY.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Unveils Artemis II Crew's Survival Suits
en.description: NASA reveals the Orion Crew Survival System suits that the four Artemis II astronauts will wear for the first crewed lunar flight since Apollo.
en.author: Monika Luabeya

en.title: NASA Artemis II Crewed Lunar Mission Enters Final Week Countdown
en.description: On March 27, 2026, NASA Artemis II is one week from launch — the first crewed lunar orbit flight since Apollo 17 in 1972.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China-Europe SMILE Satellite Completes Pre-Launch Preparations Ahead of April 9 Launch
en.description: The China Academy of Sciences announced on March 26, 2026 that the China-ESA joint SMILE satellite has completed all pre-launch preparations at the Kourou Launch Center, scheduled for April 9 local time aboard Vega-C.
en.author: CNSA / ESA

en.title: China Launches Shiyan-33 Satellite for Space Environment Testing
en.description: China successfully launched the Shiyan-33 satellite on March 27, 2026, using a Long March 2C rocket with Yuanzheng-1S upper stage from Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center.
en.author: CNSA

en.title: How Europe Will Power the Journey to the Moon and Back - ESA Artemis II Service Module Video
en.description: On March 27, 2026, ESA released a video explaining the European Service Module for Artemis II - providing propulsion, power, and life support for the crewed lunar orbit mission.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: ESA's First Celeste Satellites Set for Launch Aboard Rocket Lab Electron
en.description: On March 27, 2026, ESA announced the first two Celeste satellites will launch on March 28 at 10:14 CET aboard a Rocket Lab Electron rocket from New Zealand — Europe's first LEO-PNT demonstration mission.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Developing First Nuclear-Powered Interplanetary Spacecraft
en.description: NASA is working on the first nuclear-powered interplanetary spacecraft, marking a new era in deep space exploration capabilities.
en.author: Keith Cooper

en.title: Artemis II Crew Arrives at Kennedy Space Center Ahead of Moon Mission
en.description: The four Artemis II astronauts and their backups arrived at Kennedy Space Center on March 27, 2026, ahead of their historic flight around the Moon scheduled for April 1.
en.author: SpacePolicyOnline

en.title: ESA's First Celeste Satellites Successfully Launched — Europe's LEO Navigation Augmentation Era Begins
en.description: On March 28, 2026, ESA's first two Celeste satellites were successfully launched aboard Rocket Lab's Electron rocket from New Zealand, marking the beginning of Europe's LEO-PNT era.
en.author: ESA

en.title: NASA Astronaut Mike Fincke Shares Details About Medical Event That Ended Crew-11 Mission Early
en.description: NASA astronaut Mike Fincke has revealed more about the medical event that caused the Crew-11 mission to return to Earth more than a month ahead of schedule in January 2026.
en.author: SpacePolicyOnline

en.title: Artemis II Crew Answers Media Questions as Launch Week Begins
en.description: On March 29, 2026, the Artemis II crew answered reporters' questions from quarantine while NASA officials provided a mission status update, three days before the planned April 1 launch.
en.author: SpacePolicyOnline

en.title: Final Preparations Underway for Artemis II Moon Mission, 80% Go Weather Forecast
en.description: NASA teams at Kennedy Space Center are making final preparations for the Artemis II launch countdown, with an 80% chance of favorable weather for the April 1 target.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Lift-2 Maiden Flight Success: China's First CBC-Configuration Rocket Reaches Orbit
en.description: CAS Space's Lift-2 rocket completed its maiden flight on March 30, 2026, deploying three satellites. The 625-ton vehicle is China's first Common Booster Core configuration launch vehicle.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: CAS Space's Lijian-2 (Yao-1) Rocket Scores Maiden Flight Success, Places Three Satellites in Orbit
en.description: On March 30, 2026 at 19:00 Beijing Time, CAS Space's Lijian-2 (Yao-1) carrier rocket successfully completed its maiden flight from the Dongfeng Commercial Space Innovation Test Zone, placing three satellites — Xinzhengcheng-01, Xinzhengcheng-02, and Tianshi-01 — into their target orbits.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Set to Launch 119 Payloads on Transporter-16 Rideshare Mission From Vandenberg
en.description: On March 30, 2026, SpaceX's Falcon 9 will launch the Transporter-16 rideshare mission from Vandenberg Space Force Base, carrying 119 payloads to orbit.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Fires Up Next-Gen V3 Starship for First Time Ahead of April Launch
en.description: SpaceX completed the first static fire test of its next-generation V3 Starship in March 2026, preparing for an April launch attempt.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Artemis II Launch Countdown Officially Underway, T-2 Days to Historic Moon Mission
en.description: NASA's Artemis II launch countdown has begun at Kennedy Space Center, with the clock ticking toward an April 1 target launch time of 6:24 p.m. EDT for the first crewed Moon mission in over 50 years.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: X1.4 Solar Flare Poses No Threat to Artemis II Launch, NASA Confirms
en.description: A massive X1.4-class solar flare erupted from the Sun on March 29, triggering radio blackouts over Asia and Australia, but NASA says space weather will not affect the Artemis II crewed Moon launch on April 1.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: ISS Expedition 74 Crew Kicks Off Week With Cygnus Cargo Training and Spacewalk Cleanup
en.description: Expedition 74 astronauts trained for the upcoming Northrop Grumman Cygnus XL cargo mission, serviced spacesuits from last week's EVA, and conducted emergency medical drills aboard the International Space Station.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Rocket Lab Receives Regulatory Approval to Acquire Mynaric, Bringing Laser Communications In-House
en.description: Rocket Lab has received German regulatory approval to acquire Mynaric AG, a leading provider of laser optical communications terminals. The deal is expected to close in April 2026.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Artemis II Successfully Launches: First Crewed Lunar Mission in Over 50 Years
en.description: NASA's Artemis II launched on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 PM EDT from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Pad 39B, sending four astronauts on an approximately 10-day journey around the Moon — the first crewed lunar flight since Apollo 17 in 1972.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Chinese Startup Sustain Space Validates Flexible Robotic Arm On-Orbit, Advancing Servicing Capabilities
en.description: Sustain Space's Xiyuan-0 satellite successfully completed on-orbit demonstrations of a flexible robotic arm, verifying four operation modes including autonomous refueling simulation, teleoperation, and force-controlled manipulation.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Artemis II Flight Day 2: TLI Burn Complete, Orion Officially En Route to the Moon
en.description: NASA's Orion spacecraft successfully completed the translunar injection burn at 7:49 PM EDT, firing for 5 minutes and 50 seconds. The four astronauts are now on their way to the Moon for the first time in 53 years.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Soyuz-5 (Irtysh) Medium-Launch Vehicle Flight Test from Baikonur
en.description: Russia's next-generation medium-class launch vehicle Soyuz-5, also known as Irtysh, conducted its first test flight from Baikonur Cosmodrome on April 3. Launch result pending official confirmation.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Files Confidential IPO Registration with SEC, Targeting Record-Breaking Public Offering
en.description: SpaceX has confidentially filed for an IPO with the SEC, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1.75 trillion and potentially raising up to $50 billion — which would surpass Saudi Aramco as the largest IPO in history.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Tianlong-3 Maiden Flight Fails: China's Falcon 9-Class Commercial Rocket Loses Control After Liftoff
en.description: Space Pioneer's Tianlong-3 rocket launched from Jiuquan on April 3 but experienced an anomaly ~33 seconds after liftoff, resulting in loss of the vehicle. The company has initiated a failure investigation.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Artemis II Flight Day 3: Crew More Than Halfway to the Moon, Koch Sights Moon from Docking Hatch
en.description: Artemis II is more than halfway to the Moon. The trajectory correction burn was cancelled, Christina Koch spotted the Moon from the docking hatch, and the crew is preparing for the April 6 lunar flyby.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Atlas V Launches 29 Amazon Leo Satellites on LA-05 Mission, Accelerating Constellation Buildout
en.description: ULA Atlas V 551 successfully launched 29 Amazon Leo broadband internet satellites from Cape Canaveral SFS on the LA-05 mission.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Northrop Grumman CRS-24 Resupply Mission Targeting April 8 Launch to ISS
en.description: NASA, Northrop Grumman, and SpaceX are targeting April 8 for the CRS-24 launch, delivering approximately 11,000 pounds of science and cargo to the International Space Station.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Shenzhou-21 Crew Completes Second EVA, Approaching 150-Day On-Orbit Milestone
en.description: Taikonauts Zhang Lu, Wu Fei, and Zhang Hongzhang have completed their second spacewalk and continue science experiments aboard the Tiangong space station, nearing 150 days in orbit.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China-ESA SMILE Satellite Completes Launch Preparations, Set for April 9 Vega-C Liftoff
en.description: The SMILE satellite, jointly developed by CAS and ESA, has completed all launch preparations at Kourou and is scheduled for launch on April 9 aboard a Vega-C rocket.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Artemis II Flight Day 4: Deep-Space Flying, Lunar Flyby Prep as Glover Takes Manual Control
en.description: On Flight Day 4, the Artemis II crew is approximately 169,000 miles from Earth. Victor Glover will manually pilot Orion to test deep-space handling qualities, and the crew is preparing for Monday's lunar flyby.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Artemis II Orion Spacecraft Toilet Malfunction: Frozen Waste Line and Burning Smell En Route to Moon
en.description: Orion spacecraft experienced a burning odor and frozen waste vent on Flight Day 3 of Artemis II. Crew temporarily using emergency urine bags while ground control works on a de-icing plan.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Chang'e-4 Data Reveals 'Cosmic Ray Cavity' in Cislunar Space
en.description: A Shandong University team discovers a significant reduction in galactic cosmic ray flux near lunar orbit using three years of Chang'e-4 data, offering new insights for deep space radiation protection.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Achieves First Precise Thermal Conductivity Measurement of Single Lunar Soil Particles
en.description: A joint research team measured Chang'e-5 lunar soil single-particle thermal conductivity, discovering agglutinate particles with conductivity as low as ~8 mW·m⁻¹·K⁻¹, rivaling synthetic aerogels.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Saudi Arabia's 'Shams' Satellite Launches Aboard Artemis II on First National Space Weather Mission
en.description: The Saudi-developed Shams satellite has established initial communication after launching on Artemis II, marking the kingdom's first national-level space weather monitoring mission.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Shenzhou-21 Crew Surpasses Five Months in Orbit, Space Station Experiments Progress
en.description: Shenzhou-21 crew members Zhang Lu, Wu Fei, and Zhang Hongzhang have been in orbit for over five months, completing multiple space medicine experiments and station maintenance tasks.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Starship V3 First Flight Delayed to May — Third Consecutive Postponement
en.description: Elon Musk announced Starship V3's maiden flight is delayed another 4-6 weeks, pushing from April to early May in the third delay this year.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: LandSpace's Zhang Xiaodong: Zhuque-3 to Sprint for Reuse Testing in First Half of 2026, Building Low-Cost 'Bus' for Space Computing
en.description: At the 2026 Space Computing Industry Conference, Zhang Xiaodong, chief designer of LandSpace's reusable Zhuque-3 rocket, announced plans for recovery tests in H1 2026 and aiming for the first reusable flight by Q4 2026.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: 2026 China Space Conference (CSC2026) to be Held in Chengdu on April 23-26
en.description: The 2026 China Space Conference (CSC2026), themed 'Seventy Years Exploring the Heavens, Journeying the Nine Realms Together,' will be held in Chengdu from April 23-26, 2026, inviting renowned experts, scholars, and managers from domestic and international aerospace fields to discuss the blueprint for high-quality aerospace development.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Artemis II Completes Lunar Flyby: Breaks Apollo 13 Distance Record at 406,771 km from Earth
en.description: Artemis II crew successfully completed the lunar flyby, with Orion passing about 6,500 km above the Moon's far side and surpassing Apollo 13's crewed distance record at 406,771 km from Earth.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Completes First Return Correction Burn for Artemis II Mission, Progressing Smoothly
en.description: NASA successfully completed the first return correction burn on Artemis II mission day 7, with Orion spacecraft adjusting return trajectory as astronauts conduct various flight tests.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Hungary Taps Northrop Grumman for First National GEO Communications Satellite HUSAT
en.description: Hungary signed a contract with Northrop Grumman to build HUSAT, its first national geostationary communications satellite, developed jointly with Hungary's 4iG Group and targeting a 2028 launch.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Administrator Isaacman Defends Steep Budget Cuts, Pledges Focus on 'Bold Goals'
en.description: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman defended the Trump administration's proposed ~20% budget cut to NASA during congressional hearings, arguing the agency will be more efficient and focus on bold exploration goals.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Halts Work on SLS Mobile Launcher 2, Casting Doubt on Artemis IV and Beyond
en.description: NASA has ordered a stop-work on Mobile Launcher 2 (ML-2) built by Bechtel, with the project exceeding $1 billion in spending amid massive cost overruns and delays, threatening the Artemis IV timeline.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Long March 8 Launches Qianfan Constellation Batch 7 with 18 Satellites
en.description: On April 7, 2026 at 21:32 UTC, a Long March 8 rocket launched the seventh batch of 18 Qianfan LEO satellite internet constellation satellites from the Hainan Commercial Space Launch Site.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Starfish Space Raises Over $100 Million to Advance Otter On-Orbit Servicing Vehicle
en.description: In-orbit servicing startup Starfish Space closed a new funding round exceeding $100 million, aimed at accelerating development of its Otter servicing spacecraft and its first GEO mission.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Manned Space Program Officially Releases Tianzhou 10 Mission Identifier
en.description: The China Manned Space Engineering Office officially released the mission identifier for Tianzhou 10, featuring a circular design symbolizing harmony between heaven and Earth, with golden gradient lines representing aerospace power.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Northrop Grumman CRS-24 ISS Resupply Mission Delayed Again to April 11
en.description: NG-24 launch has been postponed three times from its original April 8 date to NET April 11, 7:41 a.m. EDT. The Cygnus cargo spacecraft will carry over 8,000 lbs of science and supplies to the ISS.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Chang'e 7 Probe Arrives at Wenchang Launch Center for Planned 2026 Launch
en.description: Chang'e 7 probe has safely arrived at Wenchang launch center, targeting breakthrough technologies for lunar south pole exploration
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Isar Aerospace Spectrum Rocket Set for Second Test Flight, a Key Test for European Commercial Launch
en.description: German launch startup Isar Aerospace plans to launch its Spectrum rocket on a second test flight from Norway's Andøya Spaceport on April 9, carrying 5 CubeSats and 1 technology payload, after three prior delays.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Long March-6A Launches Mega Constellation Satellites, Successfully Deploys 21 Low-Earth Orbit Satellites
en.description: At 03:38 Beijing Time on April 9, 2026, Long March-6A YA-17 rocket successfully deployed 21 low-Earth orbit satellite internet satellites into the intended polar orbit.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: iQPS Books Three Additional Electron Launches, Deepening Multi-Year Partnership with Rocket Lab
en.description: On April 9, 2026, Japanese SAR satellite operator iQPS signed an agreement with Rocket Lab for three additional Electron launches, further deepening their years-long partnership.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Launches 21 Satellite Internet LEO Satellites
en.description: On April 9, 2026 at 03:38 UTC, China successfully launched a batch of 21 low-Earth-orbit satellites for its satellite internet constellation, using the Long March 6 Modified rocket from Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China-ESA Joint SMILE Satellite Launch Postponed Due to Vega-C Technical Issue, New Date TBC
en.description: ESA announced the postponement of the SMILE science satellite launch, originally scheduled for April 9 on a Vega-C rocket, due to a technical issue with a subsystem component. A new launch date is yet to be determined.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Confident in Artemis II Heat Shield: Orion Spacecraft Thermal Protection System Ensures Safe Return
en.description: NASA confirms Artemis II Orion spacecraft heat shield performance reliable, thermal protection will guarantee crew safety during 24,000 mph atmospheric re-entry.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Artemis II Science Underway as Orion Begins Return Trip to Earth
en.description: Artemis II crew captured over 175 GB of images during lunar flyby; experimental laser comms payload returned 20 GB in 45 minutes. Splashdown set for April 10, 8:07 PM EDT off San Diego.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Chang'e-7 Spacecraft Arrives at Wenchang Launch Site, Planned for Launch in Second Half of 2026
en.description: China's Chang'e-7 spacecraft has safely arrived at Wenchang Satellite Launch Center, scheduled for launch in the second half of 2026, conducting lunar south pole exploration and resource survey.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Launches Long March Rockets for Thousand Sails and Guowang Megaconstellations
en.description: China conducted two Long March launches this week, adding 18 satellites to the Thousand Sails constellation (126 total) and the 21st group to Guowang (168 operational satellites).
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: ESA's Celeste Satellite Successfully Broadcasts First Navigation Signal, Launching New LEO Navigation Era
en.description: ESA's Celeste satellite successfully broadcasts first navigation signal from low Earth orbit, marking a significant milestone for Europe's low-orbit navigation system.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Artemis II Successful Splashdown: Historic Crewed Lunar Mission Completes
en.description: NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen safely complete the first crewed lunar flyby in over 50 years, Orion spacecraft splashes down in Pacific Ocean.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Cygnus XL Cargo Spacecraft Docks with ISS
en.description: Northrop Grumman's second Cygnus XL cargo spacecraft successfully docked with the International Space Station, delivering approximately 5,800 pounds of supplies and scientific experiment equipment.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Rocket Lab CSD Satellite Dispensers Successfully Deploy CubeSats on Artemis II
en.description: Rocket Lab's Canisterized Satellite Dispensers successfully deployed 4 CubeSats on NASA's Artemis II mission, including Korea's KASA K-Rad Cube, operating at altitudes up to 40,000 km.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Rocket Lab Unveils New Gauss Hall-Effect Propulsion System Designed for Mass Production Constellations
en.description: Rocket Lab introduces the Gauss series of new Hall-effect satellite thrusters on April 14, 2026, designed for high-volume production to meet the growing demand for reliable satellite positioning across mega-constellations from hundreds to tens of thousands of satellites.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Deploys 1,000th Starlink Satellite of 2026
en.description: SpaceX successfully launched its 1,000th Starlink satellite of 2026 via Falcon 9, marking the company's 37th dedicated Starlink mission of the year with 1,002 total Starlink satellites deployed in 2026.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA's Parker Solar Probe Finds Surprises in Solar Explosion
en.description: NASA's Parker Solar Probe captured unprecedented data on magnetic reconnection during a 2022 solar flyby, revealing that protons and heavy ions accelerate differently—contrary to theoretical predictions.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SOHO Coronagraph Captures Sungrazer Comet Disintegrating Near the Sun
en.description: On April 4, 2026, Comet C/2026 A1 (MAPS), a Kreutz sungrazing comet, disintegrated during its approach to the Sun, with NASA's and ESA's SOHO spacecraft capturing the event.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Giant BlueBird 7 Mobile Phone Satellite to Be Deorbited After Blue Origin New Glenn Places It in Wrong Orbit
en.description: AST SpaceMobile's BlueBird 7 satellite, launched on Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket, was deployed into an incorrect orbit and will need to be deorbited.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Commercial Space Safety Regulatory Meeting Held in Beijing: Key Tasks for 2026 Deployed
en.description: On April 14, 2026, the China National Space Administration held a commercial space safety regulatory meeting in Beijing to review 2025 work and deploy key tasks for 2026.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Launches High-Precision Greenhouse Gas Detection Satellite on Long March-4C
en.description: China successfully launched a high-precision greenhouse gas detection satellite from Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center using a Long March-4C rocket.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA's Mobile Launcher Returns to VAB Ahead of Artemis III Mission
en.description: NASA transported the Mobile Launcher 1 used in the Artemis II mission from Launch Pad 39B to the Vehicle Assembly Building at Kennedy Space Center, preparing for Artemis III crewed lunar landing operations.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA's SPHEREx Observatory Maps Interstellar Ice in Milky Way
en.description: NASA's SPHEREx mission has captured the chemical signatures of water ice and complex organic molecules in the Cygnus X star-forming region, providing new insights into the universe's water reservoirs and the chemistry of life.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Shenzhou 21 Crew Completes Third EVA, Commander Zhang Lu Sets New Record
en.description: Shenzhou 21 astronauts Zhang Lu, Wu Fei and Zhang Hongzhang successfully completed their third extravehicular activity, installing space debris shielding and inspecting external equipment, with Zhang Lu now holding China's record for most spacewalks.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Shuts Off Instrument on Voyager 1 to Keep Spacecraft Operating
en.description: NASA announced the shutdown of the Low-energy Charged Particles experiment (LECP) aboard Voyager 1 to conserve power and extend the mission of humanity's first interstellar explorer.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Blue Origin's Third New Glenn Flight Fails to Reach Target Orbit
en.description: Blue Origin's third New Glenn rocket successfully recovers a reused booster, but the payload falls short of its intended orbit
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Blue Origin New Glenn Suffers First Launch Failure on BlueBird Block 2 Mission
en.description: On April 19, 2026, Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket experienced an anomaly during its fourth flight, failing to deliver the AST SpaceMobile BlueBird Block 2 satellite to orbit. This marked the first launch failure for the New Glenn vehicle since its maiden flight in January 2025.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Blue Origin New Glenn NG-3 Mission Success with First Booster Reuse
en.description: Blue Origin successfully launched its third New Glenn rocket on NG-3 mission, carrying AST SpaceMobile's BlueBird 7 satellite to orbit while achieving the company's first booster reuse milestone.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Completes 600th Falcon Booster Landing Milestone
en.description: SpaceX successfully completed its 600th Falcon booster landing during the Starlink 17-22 mission from Vandenberg, with the 191st landing on drone ship Of Course I Still Love You.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Releases Initial Artemis II Post-Flight Assessment: Orion Heat Shield Outperforms Expectations
en.description: On April 20, 2026, NASA released its initial post-flight assessment for the Artemis II mission, finding that Orion's heat shield performed better than expected with significantly reduced char loss compared to Artemis I, providing critical data for the planned 2027 crewed lunar landing.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Rolls Out Artemis III SLS Core Stage for Moon Mission
en.description: NASA rolled out the SLS core stage for the Artemis III crewed Moon landing mission on April 20, 2026, transporting the 212-foot stage from Michoud Assembly Facility to Kennedy Space Center via Pegasus barge.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Space Day 2026 Activities Announced
en.description: The 11th China Space Day on April 24, 2026 coincides with the 70th anniversary of China's space industry and the 10th anniversary of the Space Day. The main event will be held in Chengdu, Sichuan, with Brazil as the guest of honor.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Hubble Telescope Releases New Image of Trifid Nebula for 36th Launch Anniversary
en.description: NASA's Hubble Space Telescope released a new image of the Trifid Nebula on April 24, 2026, its 36th launch anniversary, capturing a star-forming region in the constellation Sagittarius with unprecedented detail.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Latvia Signs Artemis Accords, Becomes 62nd Signatory
en.description: On April 20, 2026, Latvia's Minister for Education and Science Dace Melbārde signed the Artemis Accords at NASA Headquarters, officially becoming the 62nd signatory of the international space exploration cooperation framework.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Invites Media to SpaceX's 34th Commercial Resupply Mission, Targeting May 12 Launch
en.description: On April 20, 2026, NASA released a media advisory inviting media to cover SpaceX's 34th Commercial Resupply Services (CRS-34) mission, targeted for launch no earlier than May 12 from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, delivering over 5 metric tons of science investigations, supplies, and equipment to the International Space Station.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA's X-59 Quiet Supersonic Aircraft Completes Wheel-Up Flight Tests
en.description: NASA's X-59 quiet supersonic research aircraft completed its highest and fastest flights to date on April 14, 2026, marking a key transition from ground roll to wheels-up flight operations over the Mojave Desert.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: CNSA Holds Enterprise Roundtable on High-Quality Commercial Space Development
en.description: On April 21, CNSA Administrator Shan Zhongde chaired a roundtable with 14 commercial space enterprises to discuss R&D, licensing, launch applications, and other key issues for high-quality development.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Hubble Releases Stunning New Image of the Crab Nebula on Its 36th Anniversary
en.description: NASA's Hubble Space Telescope captures its most detailed image of the Crab Nebula supernova remnant, revealing filament expansion at 3.4 million miles per hour and a new era of multi-telescope observations.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Curiosity Rover Finds Most Diverse Collection of Organic Molecules Ever Discovered on Mars
en.description: NASA's Curiosity Mars rover has discovered the greatest diversity of organic molecules ever found on Mars, including seven compounds detected for the first time on the Red Planet, in a rock sample drilled in 2020.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Successfully Launches GPS III SV10: Final GPS III Satellite Reaches Orbit Named After Hedy Lamar
en.description: SpaceX successfully launched GPS III SV10, the tenth and final satellite in the U.S. GPS III constellation upgrade program, aboard a Falcon 9 rocket on April 21, 2026, further enhancing GPS accuracy and anti-jamming capabilities.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: What Are Ames' Contributions to Artemis II?
en.description: NASA's Ames Research Center played key roles in the Artemis II mission, providing heat shield sensors, SLS rocket vibration analysis, crew science training, and mission assurance support.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Partners with Organ Sharing Network UNOS to Study Faster Organ Transport
en.description: NASA's Langley Research Center partners with the United Network for Organ Sharing (UNOS) to explore aerospace technologies for accelerating organ transport, with the goal of improving transplant success rates.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Releases Artemis II Image and Video Recap: Key Mission Milestones
en.description: NASA publishes a comprehensive image and video recap of the Artemis II mission, highlighting Orion spacecraft's journey since its April 1 launch, covering launch preparation through translunar injection.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Earth Observatory Image: Green Belts in Washington Suburbs
en.description: NASA Earth Observatory releases an ISS astronaut photograph showing green spaces weaving through the developed landscape along the Capital Beltway in Maryland, published as Image of the Day on Earth Day 2026.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: 2026 China Space Conference (CSC2026) to Open in Chengdu on April 23
en.description: The 2026 China Space Conference (CSC2026) will be held in Chengdu from April 23-26, themed "70 Years of Space Exploration, Together for the Stars," marking the 70th anniversary of China's space program. Major announcements on deep-space exploration and commercial space policy are expected.

en.title: Curiosity Rover Sols 4867-4872: Exploring Antofagasta Crater and Selecting Next Drill Target
en.description: During sols 4867-4872, NASA's Curiosity rover explored the rim of the 10-meter Antofagasta crater on Mars. Due to excessive sand fill at the crater bottom posing a stuck-risk, the mission team abandoned drilling plans and instead conducted detailed imaging and compositional analysis of polygonal bedrock features on the crater rim.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Long March 4C Successfully Launches Atmospheric Monitoring Satellite
en.description: On April 17, 2026, China's Long March 4C rocket successfully launched the Daqi-2 (AEMS) atmospheric environment monitoring satellite from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Selects SpaceX Falcon Heavy to Launch ESA Rosalind Franklin Mars Rover
en.description: NASA announced on April 16, 2026, that it has begun implementation to launch ESA's Rosalind Franklin Mars rover in 2028 aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket, resolving years of launch uncertainties for the rover.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: FAA Grounds Blue Origin's New Glenn After Launch Fails to Deliver Payload to Correct Orbit
en.description: The FAA has ordered Blue Origin to cease New Glenn launches pending investigation after the rocket's third flight on April 20 failed to deliver its payload to the intended orbit due to one of two second stage engines malfunctioning.

en.title: China's First Batch of International Astronauts Selected
en.description: China's manned space program completed its first selection of international astronauts in April 2026, with two Pakistani candidates selected to begin training.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Rocket Lab HASTE Mission Success: Bubbles Scientific Payload Completes Suborbital Flight
en.description: Rocket Lab launched the HASTE mission on April 22, 2026 at 00:00 UTC (Hypersonic Accelerator Suborbital Test Experiment) mission with the Bubbles scientific payload aboard an Electron rocket from Wallops Flight Facility, Virginia.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Rocket Lab HASTE Successfully Launches Hypersonic Test Mission
en.description: Rocket Lab launched the second HASTE hypersonic test mission from Wallops Flight Facility, Virginia on April 22, 2026
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Infineon Radiation-Hardened Semiconductors Pass Space Validation on Artemis II Mission
en.description: Infineon reports that its radiation-hardened semiconductors supplied for NASA's Artemis II Orion spacecraft maintained zero failure during the deep-space mission, successfully supporting power management, system control, and data communications.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Jordan Officially Signs Artemis Accords, Becomes 63rd Signatory
en.description: The Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan officially signed the Artemis Accords during a ceremony at NASA Headquarters on April 23, becoming the 63rd signatory globally.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Drone Ship JRTI Completes Final Falcon 9 Landing
en.description: SpaceX's drone ship Just Read the Instructions (JRTI) completed its 156th Falcon booster recovery on April 21, marking the end of JRTI's Falcon 9 recovery era as the ship transitions to support Starship operations.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA's Modified Boeing 777 Returns to Fleet as Next-Generation Airborne Science Laboratory
en.description: NASA's Boeing 777 has returned to the agency's fleet after undergoing heavy structural modifications to become NASA's next-generation airborne science laboratory.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA to Host News Conference with Astronaut Anil Menon on Upcoming ISS Mission
en.description: NASA will host a news conference at Johnson Space Center on April 29 to preview astronaut Anil Menon's upcoming mission to the International Space Station.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Earth Observatory Releases Satellite Image of Green Spaces in Washington Suburbs
en.description: NASA Earth Observatory publishes an astronaut photograph from the International Space Station showing the distribution of green spaces along the Capital Beltway in Maryland, including the historic planned community of Greenbelt and NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Releases New Earth Views from Artemis II Mission: Phytoplankton Blooms and Auroras Captured
en.description: NASA releases new Earth imagery captured during the Artemis II lunar flyby, showing phytoplankton blooms off the Kamchatka Peninsula and auroras, showcasing Earth's dynamic ocean and atmosphere.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Invests $16.3 Million to Support Small and Medium Space Enterprises
en.description: NASA awards approximately $16.3 million in seed funding to over 30 small businesses through SBIR/STTR programs to develop innovative technologies for lunar exploration, Mars missions, and Earth applications.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA at SXSW: Johnson Director Vanessa Wyche on Why Artemis Changes Everything
en.description: NASA Johnson Space Center Director Vanessa Wyche outlined NASA's Artemis program and humanity's next steps into deep space at SXSW 2026, emphasizing the program's role in returning humans to the Moon and building the foundation for Mars missions.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Wins Two Webby Awards and Five People's Voice Awards at 30th Annual Ceremony
en.description: NASA was recognized at the 30th Annual Webby Awards with two Webby Awards and five People's Voice Awards, highlighting the agency's excellence in digital communication and public engagement across its online platforms.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Blue Origin's New Glenn Rocket Fails to Reach Orbit
en.description: Blue Origin's New Glenn heavy-lift rocket failed during the BlueBird Block 2 #2 mission on April 19, marking the second major setback for the rocket.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Releases Earth Day Image Captured by Artemis II Crew
en.description: NASA releases a stunning image of Earth's terminator — the line between day and night — captured by the Artemis II crew during their lunar flyby, released on Earth Day 2026.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Rocket Lab Completes Mynaric Acquisition, Bolstering Laser Communications Portfolio
en.description: Rocket Lab announces the completion of its acquisition of Mynaric, incorporating laser optical communications technology into its growing space systems portfolio.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Targets Early September for Roman Space Telescope Launch
en.description: NASA announced its Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope team is now targeting launch as soon as early September 2026, ahead of the agency's commitment to flight no later than its scheduled date.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Tiankong Constellation Officially Launched: China's First 220-Satellite Infrared Constellation Plan Unveiled
en.description: On April 22, the first Tiankong Infrared Satellite Industry Conference was held in Shanghai, where Weixing Technology announced the launch of the Tiankong Constellation — China's first commercial infrared satellite constellation planned with 220 satellites. Featuring sensing-computing integrated design, the constellation will enable second-level target identification and minute-level early warning, with first batch of 10 satellites slated for launch by end of 2026.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Russia Successfully Launches Angara-1.2 Rocket with Military Satellite
en.description: On April 23, 2026 at 11:29 Moscow Time, Russia's Angara-1.2 light rocket successfully lifted off from the Plesetsk Cosmodrome carrying a military satellite, which entered its designated orbit.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Space Conference 2026 (CSC2026) Opens in Chengdu
en.description: The China Space Conference 2026 (CSC2026) officially opened on April 23 in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, celebrating the 70th anniversary of China's space industry with the theme '70 Years of Space Exploration, Together We Reach for the Stars'.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Rocket Lab 85th Mission Successfully Deploys JAXA Rideshare Satellites
en.description: Rocket Lab's 85th mission successfully deployed 8 Japanese satellites including educational cubesats, an ocean monitoring satellite and multispectral camera demonstrator from New Zealand
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Johnson Space Center Leaders Honored by National Space Club & Foundation
en.description: Two outstanding leaders from NASA's Johnson Space Center were recognized by the National Space Club & Foundation for their contributions to human spaceflight.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Jordan Signs Artemis Accords, Becomes 63rd Signatory Nation
en.description: The Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan signed the Artemis Accords during a ceremony at NASA headquarters, becoming the 63rd signatory nation and further expanding international participation in the Artemis program.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA's Chandra Finds Young Sun-like Stars Dim Quickly in X-rays
en.description: A new study using NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory reveals that young Sun-like stars emit far less X-ray radiation than expected, potentially benefiting the development of life-sustaining conditions around exoplanets in their orbit.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Announces SpaceX Crew-13 Mission Assignments
en.description: NASA assigns four crew members from three space agencies for the SpaceX Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station, launching no earlier than mid-September 2026.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA's Dragonfly Rotorcraft Enters Final Assembly and Testing Phase
en.description: NASA's Dragonfly mission to Saturn's moon Titan enters final assembly and testing phase, with the team beginning installation of panels that make up the rotorcraft lander's body, planned for launch no earlier than 2027.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Develops IV Fluid Technology for Space, Enabling Deep Space Human Missions
en.description: NASA is developing a system that can produce intravenous fluids in microgravity, addressing the challenge of storing liquid medications during long-duration deep space missions.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Tests IVGEN Mini System to Produce IV Fluid Aboard ISS
en.description: NASA's IVGEN Mini system successfully demonstrated aboard the ISS in April 2026, producing IV fluid on-demand to address the challenge of limited shelf life for pre-packed medical supplies on deep space missions.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Johnson Leaders Honored by National Space Club & Foundation
en.description: Two leaders from NASA's Johnson Space Center were recognized at the 69th Annual Robert H. Goddard Memorial Dinner, with Orion Program Manager Howard Hu receiving the Norman L. Baker Astronautics Engineer Award.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Releases LAVA Aerodynamics Software to US Aerospace Industry
en.description: NASA has released its internal Launch, Ascent, and Vehicle Aerodynamics (LAVA) software to the US aerospace industry to help solve aerodynamic design challenges for advanced vehicles such as scramjet-powered aircraft.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Kennedy Prepares Facility for Roman Space Telescope Arrival
en.description: NASA's Kennedy Space Center is preparing facilities for the arrival of the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, scheduled to launch no earlier than September on a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Earth Observatory: Seasonal Fires Shroud Northern Thailand
en.description: NASA Earth observation satellite captures smoke from seasonal fires shrouding northern Thailand and Southeast Asia
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Rocket Lab Completes 85th Mission and First Dedicated Launch for European Space Agency
en.description: On April 23, 2026, Rocket Lab successfully completed the 85th Electron launch from Launch Complex 1 in Mahia Peninsula, New Zealand, carrying the JAXA Kakushin Rising rideshare satellite.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: 2026 Space Art and Culture Forum Held in Chengdu
en.description: The 2026 Space Art and Culture Forum was held in Chengdu, Sichuan Province on April 23, 2026, themed on inspiring innovation and creativity in space culture.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Launches Starlink Group 17-14 Mission
en.description: On April 23, 2026 UTC, SpaceX successfully launched the Starlink Group 17-14 mission with 20 satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base aboard a Falcon 9 Block 5 rocket.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Chang'e-7 Lunar South Pole Mission to Launch This Year
en.description: China announces Chang'e-7 lunar south pole mission will launch in 2026, marking a new phase of China's lunar exploration program.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: 11th China Space Day: 70 Years of Journey to the Stars
en.description: April 24, 2026 marks the 11th China Space Day, coinciding with the 70th anniversary of China's space industry. Tianwen-3 Mars sample return officially unveiled, Chang'e-7 to launch this year, Beidou precision and next-gen crew spacecraft progressing steadily.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China's Space Program: 70 Years of Historic Achievements and the Path to Becoming a Space Power
en.description: April 24 marks the 11th China Space Day, coinciding with the 70th anniversary of China's space endeavors. Highlights include Shenzhou-21 crew setting new EVA records, a 16-day emergency launch response capability, and China's space station operating routinely.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: 2026 Marks China's Commercial Space Mass Production Era with 100 Plus Launches Projected
en.description: In 2026, China targets over 100 total launches with commercial launches exceeding 60. Blue Arrow Space and CAS Space are both filing for STAR Market IPOs as commercial space enters its "mass production era".
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: CNSA and SAMR Jointly Release Commercial Space Standard System (Version 1.0)
en.description: China's National Space Administration and State Administration for Market Regulation jointly released the Commercial Space Standard System (Version 1.0) at the 11th China Space Day ceremony, covering the full industry chain with over 1,000 planned standard projects.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Space Conference Releases 2026 Top 10 Scientific and Technological Challenges in Astronautics
en.description: The China Space Conference 2026 (CSC2026) released its annual top 10 scientific and technological challenges in astronautics on April 23, covering cislunar spatiotemporal reference frames, lunar regolith in-situ power generation, space traffic management, LEO megaconstellations, extraterrestrial robots, POGO suppression, nuclear thermal propulsion, cryogenic infrared hyperspectral imaging, space-based ocean profile observation, and low-cost satellite manufacturing.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Hubble Space Telescope Releases New Image of Trifid Nebula, Marking 36th Launch Anniversary
en.description: NASA's Hubble Space Telescope releases a high-resolution image of the Trifod Nebula, celebrating its 36th launch anniversary on April 24.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Long March 2D Launch Successful
en.description: Long March 2D rocket successfully launched from Xichang Satellite Launch Center on April 24, 2026 at 06:25 UTC, placing its payload into orbit.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Astronauts to Answer Questions from Missouri Students from Space Station
en.description: NASA announces that astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway will answer pre-recorded STEM questions from Missouri students during their space station mission.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA's University Leadership Initiative Celebrates a Decade of Breakthrough Aviation Innovation
en.description: NASA announces the 10th anniversary of its University Leadership Initiative (ULI), which has helped NASA produce breakthrough innovations in aviation while fostering the next generation of aviation workforce.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Launches Satellite Internet Technology Test Satellites via Long March 2D
en.description: On April 24, 2026, China successfully launched four satellite internet technology test satellites aboard a Long March 2D rocket from Xichang Satellite Launch Center, marking a breakthrough in direct-to-cell satellite broadband technology.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Space Public Welfare Ambassador Visits Sichuan University
en.description: On April 24, the China Space Public Welfare Ambassador campus event was held at Sichuan University, featuring Beidou deputy chief designer Xie Jun, CAS academician Zhang Bing, and Shenzhou-17 astronaut Jiang Xinlin with over 400 teachers and students.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Tianwen-3 Mars Sample Return: Launch Planned for ~2028, Return with Samples by ~2031
en.description: CNSA officially unveiled Tianwen-3 mission plan at the 11th China Space Day: launch around 2028, return with Mars samples around 2031, with an open international cooperation call offering 20 kg of payload mass.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Opens Xihe-2 Solar Observatory to International Cooperation
en.description: CNSA releases international cooperation opportunity announcement for Xihe-2 solar mission, offering approximately 15kg of payload resources for international partners.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Artemis II Crew Captures Spectacular Milky Way Photo from Beyond the Moon
en.description: NASA's Artemis II crew captured a stunning photo of the Milky Way galaxy on April 7, 2026, during their journey around the Moon aboard the Orion spacecraft, marking the first human presence beyond low Earth orbit in over 50 years.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Discovers Two New Lunar Minerals in Chang'e-5 Samples — Magnesium and Cerium Chang'e Stones
en.description: China announced on April 24, 2026, the discovery of two new lunar minerals — magnesium Chang'e stone and cerium Chang'e stone — in Chang'e-5 lunar samples, marking the 7th and 8th new minerals found in returned lunar regolith globally.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: 2026 China Aerospace Conference Main Forum Opens in Chengdu
en.description: The 2026 China Aerospace Conference main forum opened in Chengdu, Sichuan on April 24, coinciding with the 70th anniversary of China's aerospace industry, under the theme 'Seven Decades of Space Exploration, Hand in Hand to the Stars'.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX, Lockheed Martin Among 12 Companies Awarded $3.2B U.S. Space-Based Interceptor Contracts
en.description: The U.S. Space Force awarded 12 companies, including SpaceX and Lockheed Martin, contracts worth up to $3.2 billion to develop space-based interceptor prototypes under the Trump administration's Golden Dome missile defense program, with capabilities to be demonstrated by 2028.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Launches Pakistan's PRSC-EO3 Satellite on Long March 6 Rocket
en.description: On April 25, 2026 at 20:15 Beijing Time, China successfully launched Pakistan's PRSC-EO3 satellite using a Long March 6 carrier rocket from the Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, marking the 640th flight of the Long March series.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China's First Foreign Astronauts Arrive for Training at Astronaut Center
en.description: On April 24, 2026, two Pakistani astronauts officially entered the Astronaut Center of China in Beijing to begin training alongside their Chinese peers, marking the first time China has hosted foreign astronauts for systematic training.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Weiguang Qihang Unveils World's First All-Carbon Fiber Launch Vehicle at CSC2026
en.description: At the 2026 China Aerospace Conference (CSC2026) held in Chengdu from April 23-26, Beijing Weiguang Qihang Technology Co., Ltd. unveiled its core product, the 'Weiguang-1' all-carbon fiber launch vehicle, attracting widespread industry attention.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Artemis II Crew Captures Stunning 'Earthset' Photo from Orion Spacecraft
en.description: NASA Artemis II astronauts captured a breathtaking image of Earth setting behind the Moon on April 6, 2026, from the Orion spacecraft. NASA Science described it as 'one of the most spectacular views of our home planet.'
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Achieves Record 92 Space Launches in 2025, Commercial Sector Accounts for Over 50%
en.description: China's National Bureau of Statistics reports 92 orbital launches in 2025, a historic high and a 35% increase over 2024, with commercial launches accounting for 50 of them.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Galaxy Aerospace Celebrates 8th Anniversary as China's First Commercial Space Unicorn
en.description: On April 24, 2026, a satellite internet technology test satellite developed by Galaxy Aerospace was successfully launched into orbit aboard a Long March 2D rocket. The same day marked the company's 8th anniversary, having become China's first commercial space unicorn with 40+ self-developed satellites launched and the nation's first LEO broadband communication test constellation operational.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Russia Launches Progress MS-34 Cargo Spacecraft to ISS
en.description: Russia's Progress MS-34 cargo spacecraft lifted off aboard a Soyuz-2.1a rocket from Baikonur Cosmodrome, delivering over 2.5 tonnes of supplies to the International Space Station, with docking scheduled for April 28.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Nayuta Space's Qianniao-R Full-Scale Test Rocket Unveiled, China's Aerodynamic Recovery Tech Advances
en.description: Nayuta Space's Qianniao-R, China's only rocket using aerodynamic deceleration for recovery, has completed its full-scale test vehicle and control surface electrical integration tests, adopting a unique 'aerodynamic deceleration + horizontal landing' technology route with a planned maiden flight in H1 2027.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: China Space Public Welfare Ambassador Visits Sichuan University
en.description: On April 24, China's Space Public Welfare Ambassadors visited Sichuan University, where astronaut Jiang Xinlin and space experts engaged with over 400 students and faculty.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: SpaceX Completes 50th Falcon 9 Launch of 2026
en.description: SpaceX successfully completed its 50th Falcon 9 launch of 2026 on April 26, deploying 25 Starlink V2 Mini satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base and marking the 603rd booster recovery in company history.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: Artemis II Astronauts Observe Lunar Meteoroid Impacts During Mission
en.description: During the Artemis II mission in early April, astronauts observed flashes of light from meteoroids hitting the lunar surface while Earth-based volunteers simultaneously tracked the same impacts.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: CNSA Holds Enterprise Roundtable on High-Quality Commercial Space Development
en.description: On April 21, 2026, CNSA Administrator Shan Zhongde chaired a roundtable with 14 commercial space enterprise leaders to discuss R&D, licensing, launch applications, and other key issues.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Invites Public to Join Citizen Science: Everyone Can Be Part of Space Exploration
en.description: NASA published an article on April 27 introducing how the public can participate in space exploration through citizen science projects, including lunar flash observations during Artemis II and pepper plant cultivation experiments for future deep space missions.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA Develops Space IV Technology: IVGEN Mini Converts Drinking Water to Intravenous Fluid On Demand
en.description: NASA has released details of the IVGEN Mini system, which can produce medical-grade intravenous fluid on demand from drinking water aboard the International Space Station, solving the limited shelf-life problem for deep space missions.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA's Curiosity and Perseverance Rovers Release Simultaneous 360-Degree Panoramas of Mars
en.description: NASA's Curiosity and Perseverance rovers released simultaneous 360-degree panoramic images of Mars, revealing billions of years of geological history and ancient habitable conditions on the Red Planet.
en.author: Tianjiang Shuo

en.title: NASA's X-59 Supersonic Test Aircraft Unveils 'Freedom 250' Livery to Celebrate America's 250th Anniversary
